info.name: EODHD Financial Data Calendar US Treasury API
info.description:
Comprehensive API for retrieving financial data including stock prices, fundamentals, calendar events, news, and more from EOD Historical Data (eodhd.com)

Contact Support:
 Name: EODHD Support
 Email: supportlevel1@eodhistoricaldata.com

request.description: Returns daily US Treasury bill rates (discount rates for 4-week, 8-week, 13-week, 17-week, 26-week, and 52-week bills).

response.name: Data not found for specified date range.

request.description: Returns US Treasury long-term average rates and extrapolation factors for maturities beyond 30 years.

response.name: Data not found for specified date range.

item.name: Get US Treasury real yield curve rates

request.description: Returns daily US Treasury real yield curve rates (TIPS-derived real yields for 5-year, 7-year, 10-year, 20-year, and 30-year maturities).

response.name: Data not found for specified date range.

item.name: Get US Treasury yield curve rates

request.description: Returns daily US Treasury yield curve rates (constant maturity rates for 1-month through 30-year maturities).

response.name: Data not found for specified date range.
